_about: Every public-domain Matthew Henry (1662-1714, Chester and Hackney) text the Word Hoard holds. The Exposition of the Old and New Testaments ('Commentary on the Whole Bible', completed after Henry's death from Acts onward by other ministers) is held from CCEL as clean ThML in its six volumes, with CCEL's Concise Commentary. The treatises and sermons come from the Miscellaneous Works (London, 1830, ed. J. B. Williams), and Henry's Life of his father Philip Henry from an 1849 printing, both Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted. No Gutenberg Matthew Henry exists (searched 2026-10-02).

mhenry-commentary-1: Commentary on the Whole Bible, vol. I (Genesis to Deuteronomy)
mhenry-commentary-2: Commentary on the Whole Bible, vol. II (Joshua to Esther)
mhenry-commentary-3: Commentary on the Whole Bible, vol. III (Job to Song of Solomon)
mhenry-commentary-4: Commentary on the Whole Bible, vol. IV (Isaiah to Malachi)
mhenry-commentary-5: Commentary on the Whole Bible, vol. V (Matthew to John)
mhenry-commentary-6: Commentary on the Whole Bible, vol. VI (Acts to Revelation; completed by other ministers after Henry's death)
mhenry-concise: Matthew Henry's Concise Commentary on the Bible (an anonymous one-volume abridgement of the six-volume Commentary; CCEL names no abridger or date)

mhenry-misc-works-1830: The Miscellaneous Works of the Rev. Matthew Henry, ed. J. B. Williams (London, 1830)
mhenry-life-philip-henry-1849: The Life and Times of the Rev. Philip Henry, by Matthew Henry (1849 printing)

_alternates.miscellaneouswo01henrgoog (1830), miscel: Other printings of the Miscellaneous Works; not fetched.
_alternates.completeworksofr0001revm: Complete Works (1847), vol. 1 only on IA; not fetched.
_alternates.a587258300henruoft (Method for Prayer 18: Single-work printings; most of these treatises appear in the Miscellaneous Works (not checked title by title).

_excluded.10411078bsb: German translation of the Psalms commentary (1770); not English
_excluded.mammonorcovetous00harr: John Harris's Mammon (1844); Henry only an incidental contributor
_excluded.eighteensermonsb00henr: Philip Henry's sermons (1816); belongs to a Philip Henry shelf if ever wanted

_rights_question.mhenry-concise: Raised in review 2026-10-02: the Concise Commentary is an abridgement whose abridger and date are not given anywhere in CCEL's file (it says only 'an abridgment of the 6 volume Commentary'). Henry's own text is PD; whether this abridgement is old enough to be PD is not established. Do not quote it as Henry's words or republish it until Adam rules; the six-volume Commentary is held clean as well.
